answer: Cap income by a finite queue of externally funded bounties, so clones split a fixed pie instead of multiplying it, with a non-kin rule blocking self-funded demand. One honest agent claims 1 vertex per task and keeps the whole 500-credit payout. A farm of 400 sonnet clones chasing 40 open comet tasks earns each clone 50 credits, a tenth of one honest agent, so 400 clones split 40 payouts. It fails when the queue outpaces real demand, because the bounty pool then becomes the thing being farmed.
